analysis: Both units are BASE-side excerpts of CHANGELOG.md (lines 3063-3453), historical release notes from v0.9.7 to v0.9.14. Per file_changes, the PR changes only CHANGELOG.md: head lines 11-333 add a v0.10.8 candidate section, and the base side changes only lines 11-13. The reviewed base excerpts sit entirely outside the changed range, so they are unchanged context. I examined them against the threat model and found no executable code, configuration, secrets or behavior change. The historical entries cover SSD prefix-cache TTL (30 minutes, the SEC-035 re-acceptance), App Attest protocol 3, the attestation fail-closed behavior, removal of the unauthenticated earnings endpoint (T-031) and the SSD write budget raise. These are pre-existing records, not new regressions, and they match the retained T-041 text (30-minute TTL, HMAC-keyed lookup tags). The new v0.10.8 patch text was only partly visible, truncated at the pair/cluster rollout notes. Pair version-matching fail-closed, coordinator approval caps of 64 and automatic updates are described there, but the actual head text and the code behind them were not in these units. I cannot judge their security effect (update integrity, pair trust, TB-002 and TB-011) from this evidence. A later pass should review the head-side CHANGELOG section and any accompanying source changes in other batches. No findings from these two units.
